acceptance: The command refuses (clear message, non-zero exit) when metrics are suppressed or any query failed
Throughput uses the throughput phase wall duration, never summed query time
Power uses only the final power iteration
The label reflects the benchmark (QphH vs QphDS)
Tests cover each refusal and the timing source
context: 2026-10-04 throughput adversarial review (develop 8ed0c64e1). Reproduced by reviewer probe.
description:
`benchbox/core/results/metrics.py:283-303` refuses only `unofficial_subscale` runs. A result with `tpc_metrics: {"suppressed": true}` or failed queries still gets a derived score. Ts comes from `summary.timing.total_ms`, which is the sum of per-query times (schema.py:1603), not wall-clock time, so with S streams Throughput@Size is understated by about S times. The power fallback uses successful rows from every iteration. The output is always labelled TPC-H, even for TPC-DS files.

A reviewer's probe: a suppressed file with 5 failed queries returned Throughput@Size 1800 (correct would be 3600 if it were valid at all) plus a QphH.
